steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen used by the forward auction scenario.
Switch the single-stage event type from the default to Auction.
Enter the buyer's title before adding any products.
Choose the first available auction template so the product sheet can be used.
Add the first named product after the title has been entered.

steps.note: Verify that adding the first product did not replace the typed title.
Set the first product's delivery location to Plant Name.
